record_transformations: Removed source_file, source_row, sample_order, raw_fingerprint, tensor_fingerprint_exact, and tensor_fingerprint_round5 from source-level records where present.
Replaced all 12,774 distinct flow_id values with independent random 128-bit identifiers; the mapping was discarded.
Preserved all result rows, classes, targets, support counts, estimates, and adverse findings.
Rebuilt RQ2 paired-contrast bootstrap intervals and six review-diagnostic summaries after identifiers were randomized; point estimates were unchanged.
exclusions: Raw traffic data, prepared data matrices, model binaries, full attribution arrays, local environment snapshots, logs, caches, temporary outputs, superseded manuscript archives, and unrelated pipeline generations.
